description: Allocated cost per data tier (hot/content, warm, cold, frozen, or 'serverless' for Serverless projects) for one deployment, split into indexing, query, storage, and blended cost (indexing weight applied on hot/content). max_daily_storage_snapshot_bytes is the MAX of per-day summed storage snapshots in the window (not point-in-time bytes stored). Use this to judge whether data is sitting on more expensive tiers than it needs to be, and to size the opportunity for ILM changes.

configuration.query:
FROM billing_realized_pool_lookup
| EVAL billing_ts = @timestamp, billing_deployment_id = deployment_id
| LOOKUP JOIN cluster_capacity_utilization_lookup ON composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN cluster_deployment_contribution_lookup ON composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN cluster_tier_contribution_lookup ON composite_key
| EVAL ts = billing_ts
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_conf_lookup ON ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| WHERE DATE_DIFF("day", billing_ts, NOW()) <= ?days AND billing_deployment_id == ?deployment_id
| EVAL heap_util = CASE(heap_used_pct_p95 IS NULL, 100.0, heap_used_pct_p95) / 100.0, disk_util = CASE(disk_used_pct_p95 IS NULL, 100.0, disk_used_pct_p95) / 100.0
| EVAL w_sum = conf_utilization_memory_weight + conf_utilization_storage_weight, util_floor = COALESCE(TO_DOUBLE(conf_utilization_floor), 0.10)
| EVAL raw_utilization_score = CASE(w_sum > 0, (conf_utilization_memory_weight * heap_util + conf_utilization_storage_weight * disk_util) / w_sum, 1.0)
| EVAL utilization_score = CASE(raw_utilization_score < util_floor, util_floor, raw_utilization_score)
| EVAL chargeable_pool = data_tier_capacity_ecu * CASE(utilization_score IS NULL, 1.0, utilization_score)
| EVAL rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate
| EVAL idx_cost = CASE(deployment_sum_indexing_time > 0, TO_DOUBLE(tier_sum_indexing_time) / deployment_sum_indexing_time * chargeable_pool * rate, 0.0)
| EVAL qry_cost = CASE(deployment_sum_query_time > 0, TO_DOUBLE(tier_sum_query_time) / deployment_sum_query_time * chargeable_pool * rate, 0.0)
| EVAL sto_cost = CASE(deployment_sum_data_set_store_size > 0, TO_DOUBLE(tier_sum_data_set_store_size) / deployment_sum_data_set_store_size * chargeable_pool * rate, 0.0)
| EVAL w_hot = conf_indexing_weight + conf_query_weight + conf_storage_weight, w_cold = conf_query_weight + conf_storage_weight
| EVAL blended = CASE(tier == "hot/content", (idx_cost * conf_indexing_weight + qry_cost * conf_query_weight + sto_cost * conf_storage_weight) / w_hot, (qry_cost * conf_query_weight + sto_cost * conf_storage_weight) / w_cold)
| STATS indexing_cost = SUM(idx_cost), query_cost = SUM(qry_cost), storage_cost = SUM(sto_cost), blended_cost = SUM(blended), max_daily_storage_snapshot_bytes = MAX(tier_sum_data_set_store_size)
    BY tier
| SORT blended_cost DESC
| LIMIT 10

deployment_id.description: Deployment ID or Serverless project ID
